note: RFC 5575 Section 4: "Implementations wishing to exchange flow specification rules MUST use BGP's Capability Advertisement facility to exchange the Multiprotocol Extension Capability Code (Code 1) as defined in RFC 4760 [RFC4760]." RFC 8955 Section 4 restates this obligation; the existing superseded disposition is retained. TestIPv4FlowSpecNegotiatesMultiprotocolCapability is only registration/constructed-capability evidence. The current reactor/rfc5575_capability_wire_test.go TestRFC5575OpenCapabilityMatchesTransmittedFlowFamily additionally decodes buildOpen OptionalParams produced from real parsed configuration, verifies Code-1 families, and sends through AnnounceNLRIBatch. Matching SAFI sends exactly the required MP_REACH bytes; advertising only the other FlowSpec SAFI returns ErrNoPeersAcceptedFamily and writes zero bytes. Producers session_negotiate.go buildOpen, capability.Negotiate and reactor_api_batch.go AnnounceNLRIBatch/buildBatchAnnounceUpdate were read. Distinct matched/mismatched negotiation arms are a genuine positive/negative pair. Removed only the now-false single-polarity annotation. Independent source rejudgment only; no test, mutation, build or gate was executed by this auditor. Native observed-red renewal is a separate parent step.
